P_calibration.quote: Relying on structural gaps such as vessel splitting or foreign subsidiaries has costs. §2(1)(B) lets the Secretary reach below-threshold activity, and a gap that's exploited tends to get closed.

P_holdback.quote: The legal and policy teams should decide which to keep in-house and which to raise as unworkability points at markup.

P_grandfather_step.quote: Activity begun or expanded in the window isn't grandfathered, because §3(b) is keyed to licenses, not activity. The window may be lawful operating time
